difficulty_reason: Higher direct images computed on slice sites: starts from an injective resolution F[0] -> I^bullet, writes the complex computing R^i f_*F(y) from the pushforward formula, and justifies the identification of its cohomology with the cohomology of the pullback complex using that pr is representable (hence faithful by the Algebraic Stacks characterisation) and that the slice 2-fibre product has equalizers by lemma-fibre-products. Retained author proof at lines 4112-4141.
